## Overview

Notifications is a compact actionable notification row with a fixed 343px width and hug-content height. It exposes unread and read variants while keeping the same measured geometry; the state changes semantic colors rather than layout. The row contains a notification title, message, timestamp, decorative payment icon, and a referenced trailing chevron.

**Variant axes.** `State`: Unread (default), Read.

### Composition

- **chevron-right** (referenced — chevron-right) — configured inline below; full spec at `./chevron-right.md` (node `13:67`).
- _Decorative children: 2 — documented inline in Structure and Color._

## API

_Confidence: high._

The parent-level state controls whether the notification is unread or read. Semantic colors are supplied by the Colors semantic collection in Light and Dark modes; theme selection is app- or container-level rather than a per-instance prop. The notification content is exposed as title, message, and timestamp strings; the trailing chevron is a fixed referenced component and its interaction handler is an implementation concern.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| state | unread, read | unread, read | unread | Controls the notification's unread/read presentation. Source: Figma `State` axis. |
| title | string (required) | string | – | Primary notification heading. Source: TEXT layer `Top-up successful` in the extracted default variant. |
| message | string (required) | string | – | Supporting notification message. Source: TEXT layer `1,000.00 THB successfully added to your wallet` in the extracted default variant. |
| timestamp | string (required) | string | – | Timestamp or metadata line. Source: TEXT layer `2026-05-12 00:00` in the extracted default variant. |

## Voice / Screen reader

_Confidence: high._

- The notification row is treated as one focus stop. The title, message, timestamp, and layout frames merge into the row; the icon and chevron are decorative and are not separate stops.
- Unread and read remain separate states because the status changes the announcement while the single focus-stop index stays stable.
- iOS: expose one accessibility element for the actionable row, merge the visible text, expose unread/read as accessibilityValue, and use the button trait.
- Android: merge the row descendants, expose unread/read as stateDescription, and use Role.Button.
- Web: prefer a native <button> because the evidence shows an actionable notification row but provides no destination URL; associate the visible title, message, timestamp, and status with the button.
- Do not reorder focus across states; keep the stop index stable so user gestures remain predictable.
- Do not stuff the accessible name with the hint, value, and error; each belongs on its dedicated property.

### State: unread

Notification has not been read; announce the status without adding another focus stop.

#### VoiceOver (iOS)

**Focus stop 1: Notification item**

Top-up successful, 1,000.00 THB successfully added to your wallet, 2026-05-12 00:00, unread, button

| Property | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| accessibilityLabel | Top-up successful | Use the visible notification title as the concise accessible name. |
| accessibilityValue | 1,000.00 THB successfully added to your wallet, 2026-05-12 00:00, unread | Expose the message, timestamp, and unread status as the row's current value. |
| accessibilityTraits | .isButton | The notification row is the actionable control; the chevron does not become a second control. |
| accessibilityHint | Opens notification details | Describe the result of activating the row because the destination is not named by the visual content. |
| Do NOT | Expose the title, message, or timestamp as separate elements | These text nodes merge into the single notification row; do not read them twice. |
| Do NOT | Announce the icon or chevron | Both icons are decorative; mark them accessibilityHidden(true) so VoiceOver lands only on the row. |

#### TalkBack (Android)

**Focus stop 1: Notification item**

Top-up successful, 1,000.00 THB successfully added to your wallet, 2026-05-12 00:00, unread, button, double-tap to activate

| Property | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| contentDescription | Top-up successful, 1,000.00 THB successfully added to your wallet, 2026-05-12 00:00 | Merge the visible title, message, and timestamp into the row's spoken content. |
| stateDescription | Unread | Expose the notification read status separately from the spoken content. |
| role | Role.Button | The notification row is the actionable semantic control. |
| semantics | mergeDescendants = true | Keep the title, message, and timestamp within one TalkBack focus stop. |
| Do NOT | Expose the title, message, or timestamp as separate focus stops | The row merges these descendants; do not make TalkBack read the same notification content repeatedly. |
| Do NOT | Announce the icon or chevron | Both icons are decorative; set importantForAccessibility=no or equivalent semantics hiding. |

#### ARIA (Web)

**Focus stop 1: Notification item**

Top-up successful, button, 1,000.00 THB successfully added to your wallet, 2026-05-12 00:00, Unread

| Property | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| element | <button type="button"> | Prefer a native button so keyboard activation and the button role are provided by the platform. |
| role | button | The native element supplies the button role for the actionable notification row. |
| aria-labelledby | notification-title | Use the visible title node for the accessible name rather than duplicating it in aria-label. |
| aria-describedby | notification-message notification-timestamp notification-state | Associate the message, timestamp, and unread status as descriptions of the same button. |
| tabindex | 0 | Keep the single actionable notification row keyboard focusable. |
| Do NOT | Expose the title, message, or timestamp as separate focusable elements | Use one native button with labelled-by and described-by relationships so the visible content is not read twice. |
| Do NOT | Announce the icon or chevron | Both icons are decorative; set aria-hidden="true" and keep the chevron out of the tab order. |
